parameters.content:
## Alert Email Auto-Send

Sub-workflow invocado por **Alert Scheduler** (`Send Alert Email`) cuando una `alert_rules` con `auto_send_email = true` y `email_template_id` genera una `alert_instances` nueva. Es el equivalente por email de **Alert WhatsApp Auto-Send** y sigue su mismo contrato.

**Destinatario**: email del paciente; si es dependiente sin email válido, el de su responsable (`responsible_contact_id`). Se descartan emails vacíos, mal formados o con `email_bounced = true`. Solo usuarios activos con rol `paciente` (la regla de cumpleaños recorre toda la tabla `users`).

**Preferencias**: se respeta `global_notification_settings` (canal `email` + categoría de la regla; sin fila = deshabilitado). La preferencia del paciente (`user_communication_preferences`) se **ignora** por defecto: si la tenía apagada el email sale igual y queda `user_pref_overridden: true` en `alert_actions.action_data`. Una regla puede volver a respetarla con `condition_config.respect_user_preferences = true`.

**Validación en el momento del envío**: cita en `scheduled/confirmed/pending` y del paciente; factura cobrable con `effective_residual > 0` (`v_alert_invoices`).

**Plantilla**: `communication_templates` (type EMAIL). Variables `{{token}}`: patient_name, recipient_name, for_patient, to_patient, clinic_name, clinic_address, clinic_phone, clinic_email, clinic_phone_link, clinic_contact, clinic_logo, appointment_date, appointment_time, doctor_name, location, invoice_doc_no, invoice_amount, invoice_due_date, invoice_currency (alias doc_no, currency), confirm_url, cancel_url. Un token desconocido aborta el envío. Si la plantilla no trae layout propio (texto plano o HTML simple) se envuelve en el layout de la clínica; las que ya lo traen (contenedor max-width, como las por defecto del frontend) se envían tal cual.

**Modo prueba**: `system_configurations` `alert_email_test_mode_enabled = 'true'` → solo envía a `alert_email_test_whitelist` (emails separados por coma).

**Resultado**: envío OK → `alert_actions` SEND_EMAIL/SUCCESS y la alerta pasa a COMPLETED (solo si sigue PENDING). Cualquier fallo → `alert_actions` SEND_EMAIL/FAILED con el motivo, la alerta queda como está y devuelve `{ success: false }` sin cortar el loop del scheduler.

**Import checklist**: 1) elegir la credencial Gmail de la clínica en `Send Email (Gmail)`; 2) copiar el workflowId de este flujo al nodo `Send Alert Email` de Alert Scheduler.

**Botones Confirmar / Cancelar** (citas): si la plantilla usa `{{confirm_url}}` / `{{cancel_url}}`, `Build Email` genera un token aleatorio y `Store Action Token` guarda su sha256 en `appointment_action_tokens` antes de enviar (si no se puede guardar, no se envía). Los enlaces apuntan al flujo *Appointment Email Action (noauth)* y valen hasta el inicio de la cita menos `appointment_email_actions_cutoff_hours`. Una cita ya confirmada solo lleva "Cancelar"; fuera de plazo o sin `WEBHOOK_URL`, los botones se quitan.

parameters.query:
WITH ai AS (
  SELECT ai.id, ai.status, ai.reference_table, ai.reference_id, ai.patient_id,
         ac.notification_category_slug AS category_slug,
         COALESCE(ar.condition_config->>'respect_user_preferences', 'false') = 'true' AS respect_user_preferences
  FROM public.alert_instances ai
  JOIN public.alert_rules ar ON ar.id = ai.rule_id
  LEFT JOIN public.alert_categories ac ON ac.id = ar.category_id
  WHERE ai.id = $1::int
)
SELECT
  ai.id AS alert_instance_id,
  ai.status AS alert_status,
  ai.reference_table,
  ai.reference_id,
  ai.category_slug,
  ai.respect_user_preferences,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.alert_actions aa
    WHERE aa.alert_instance_id = ai.id
      AND aa.action_type = 'SEND_EMAIL'
      AND aa.result_status = 'SUCCESS'
  ) AS already_sent,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT g.is_enabled FROM public.global_notification_settings g
    WHERE g.channel_slug = 'email' AND g.category_slug = ai.category_slug
    LIMIT 1
  ), false) AS channel_enabled,
  (
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (
      SELECT ct.id, ct.code, ct.subject, ct.body_html, ct.body_text
      FROM public.communication_templates ct
      WHERE ct.id = NULLIF($2::text, '')::int
        AND ct.type = 'EMAIL'
        AND ct.is_active = true
    ) x
  ) AS template,
  (
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (
      SELECT
        u.id::text AS id,
        u.name,
        NULLIF(btrim(u.email), '') AS email,
        COALESCE(u.email_bounced, false) AS email_bounced,
        COALESCE(u.is_active, true) AS is_active,
        COALESCE(u.is_dependant, false) AS is_dependant,
        EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
          JOIN public.roles r ON r.id = ur.role_id
          WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.name = 'paciente' AND COALESCE(ur.is_active, true)
        ) AS is_patient,
        (
          SELECT p.is_enabled FROM public.user_communication_preferences p
          WHERE p.user_id = u.id AND p.channel_slug = 'email' AND p.category_slug = ai.category_slug
          LIMIT 1
        ) AS pref_enabled,
        resp.id::text AS responsible_id,
        resp.name AS responsible_name,
        NULLIF(btrim(resp.email), '') AS responsible_email,
        COALESCE(resp.email_bounced, false) AS responsible_email_bounced,
        (
          SELECT p.is_enabled FROM public.user_communication_preferences p
          WHERE p.user_id = resp.id AND p.channel_slug = 'email' AND p.category_slug = ai.category_slug
          LIMIT 1
        ) AS responsible_pref_enabled
      FROM public.users u
      LEFT JOIN public.users resp ON resp.id = u.responsible_contact_id
      WHERE u.id = ai.patient_id
    ) x
  ) AS patient,
  (
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (
      SELECT c.name, c.address, c.phone, c.email
      FROM public.clinic c
      ORDER BY c.id
      LIMIT 1
    ) x
  ) AS clinic,
  CASE WHEN ai.reference_table = 'appointments' THEN (
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (
      SELECT
        a.id,
        a.status,
        to_char(a.start_datetime, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date_iso,
        to_char(a.start_datetime, 'HH24:MI') AS time,
        d.name AS doctor_name,
        s.name AS sede_name,
        s.address AS sede_address,
        -- Botones Confirmar/Cancelar: valen hasta el inicio menos el corte
        -- configurado (hora de pared de la clínica, como start_datetime).
        to_char(a.start_datetime - cut.hours * interval '1 hour', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS actions_expire_at,
        (a.start_datetime - cut.hours * interval '1 hour') > (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Montevideo') AS actions_open
      FROM public.appointments a
      CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim((SELECT sc.value FROM public.system_configurations sc
                                      WHERE sc.key = 'appointment_email_actions_cutoff_hours' LIMIT 1)), '')::float8, 0) AS hours
      ) cut
      LEFT JOIN public.users d ON d.id = a.assignee_id
      LEFT JOIN public.calendar_sources cs ON cs.id = a.calendar_source_id
      LEFT JOIN public.sedes s ON s.id = cs.sede_id
      WHERE a.id::text = ai.reference_id
        AND a.patient_id = ai.patient_id
    ) x
  ) END AS appointment,
  CASE WHEN ai.reference_table = 'invoices' THEN (
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (
      SELECT
        v.id,
        v.doc_no,
        v.currency,
        v.effective_residual,
        v.is_collectible,
        to_char(v.due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS due_date_iso
      FROM public.v_alert_invoices v
      WHERE v.id::text = ai.reference_id
        AND v.user_id = ai.patient_id
    ) x
  ) END AS invoice,
  COALESCE((SELECT sc.value FROM public.system_configurations sc WHERE sc.key = 'alert_email_test_mode_enabled' LIMIT 1), 'false') AS test_mode_enabled,
  COALESCE((SELECT sc.value FROM public.system_configurations sc WHERE sc.key = 'alert_email_test_whitelist' LIMIT 1), '') AS test_whitelist
FROM ai;

INSERT INTO public.alert_actions
  (alert_instance_id, action_type, action_data, result_status, result_message, performed_by, performed_at)
VALUES (
  $1::int, 'SEND_EMAIL', $2::jsonb, 'SUCCESS', $3,
  NULLIF($4::text, '')::uuid,
  now()
)
RETURNING alert_instance_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.alert_instance_id, JSON.stringify({ to: $json.to, to_responsible: $json.to_responsible, recipient_name: $json.recipient_name, subject: $json.subject, template: $json.template_code, gmail_message_id: $json.gmail_message_id || null, user_pref_overridden: $json.user_pref_overridden === true }), 'Email enviado automáticamente a ' + $json.to + ($json.to_responsible ? ' (responsable)' : '') + ($json.user_pref_overridden ? ' — se ignoró la preferencia del paciente' : ''), ($('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.performed_by || '') ] }}

UPDATE public.alert_instances
SET status = 'COMPLETED',
    completed_at = now(),
    completed_by = NULLIF($2::text, '')::uuid,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int
  AND status = 'PENDING'
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.alert_instance_id, ($('When Called by Alert Scheduler').first().json.performed_by || '') ] }}

VALUES (
  $1::int, 'SEND_EMAIL', '{}'::jsonb, 'FAILED', $2,
  NULLIF($3::text, '')::uuid,
  now()
)
RETURNING alert_instance_id, result_message;

-- Guarda el sha256 del token de los botones Confirmar/Cancelar ANTES de
-- enviar: el paciente puede tocar el botón apenas le llega el email.
-- Sin token (email sin botones) no inserta nada y el flujo sigue igual.
INSERT INTO public.appointment_action_tokens
       (appointment_id, alert_instance_id, token_hash, recipient_email, expires_at)
SELECT NULLIF($1::text, '')::int,
       NULLIF($2::text, '')::int,
       $3::text,
       NULLIF($4::text, ''),
       NULLIF($5::text, '')::timestamp
WHERE NULLIF($3::text, '') IS NOT NULL
RETURNING id::text AS id;
